headline: Alex Eala Cruises Into Asian Games Quarterfinals
seoTitle: Alex Eala Reaches 2026 Asian Games Quarterfinals | FMB News
seoDescription: Top seed Alex Eala beat Thailand's Patcharin Cheapchandej 6-1, 6-0 in 55 minutes to reach the 2026 Asian Games women's singles quarterfinals.
deck: The top-seeded Filipina defeated Thailand's Patcharin Cheapchandej 6-1, 6-0 in 55 minutes and will face Joanna Garland in the quarterfinals.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Alex Eala advanced to the women's singles quarterfinals of the 2026 Asian Games after defeating Thailand's Patcharin Cheapchandej 6-1, 6-0 on Monday at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Nagoya, Japan.
GMA News recorded the completed score in its live coverage. Gulf News independently reported the same score and a match duration of 55 minutes.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Eala entered the women's singles draw as the top seed and received a first-round bye. The match was delayed by rain and moved to an indoor court before play began.
This is a quarterfinal qualification, not a medal result. Eala previously won bronze in women's singles at the 2022 Asian Games, staged in 2023.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The victory keeps the Philippines' leading women's tennis player in contention for a second straight Asian Games singles medal and a place in the semifinals.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Eala is scheduled to face Chinese Taipei's Joanna Garland in the quarterfinals on September 30.
She is also entered in women's doubles with Shaira Hope Rivera.
